articles.summary: Izzy Neale suffered injuries when her horse Marnoo fell and suffered a fatal leg injury in the homestretch of a 1-mile race.

articles.title: Thomas Markle is taken into federal custody after allegedly cutting off his ankle monitor in wake of child pornography arrest
articles.summary: Markle, 82, allegedly cut off the location monitor in the early hours of Tuesday morning, just days after his arrest for allegedly keeping child sexual abuse material in storage units in California.

articles.title: Meghan Markle's father Thomas Markle Sr. cut off his ankle monitor following child porn arrest
articles.summary: Federal judge orders Meghan Markle's father, Thomas Markle Sr., jailed without bond after he allegedly cut off his court-ordered ankle monitor.

articles.title: Black Ole Miss students racially abused by white women said one of their tormentors continued making offensive gestures while they confronted her
articles.summary: Jakiyra Metcalf, Kaiden Caldwell and Victoria G Johnson were inside their apartment on Friday evening when three white women made monkey noises and beat their chests outside their door.

articles.title: Ole Miss students ‘devastated’ by racist monkey gestures and noises captured on door camera
articles.summary: One of the women caught on camera making monkey noises and gestures at the apartment door of three Black Ole Miss students doubled down when confronted at the time, a woman who lives in the home told “[outlet] Morning.”

articles.title: Rex Ryan Arrested for Allegedly Running over Pedestrians’ Feet
articles.summary: Noted feet aficionado Rex Ryan has got to be beside himself after allegedly running over the feet of two pedestrians in Nashville last week.

articles.title: Former NFL coach Rex Ryan charged after allegedly hitting pedestrians with car in Nashville

articles.title: Joe Biden claims he would have resigned if he knew he had cancer while president
articles.summary: The 46th president announced in May 2025 that he had been diagnosed with stage 4 prostate cancer that had spread to his bones.

articles.title: Biden says he wouldn't have run for a second term in 2024 if he knew he had cancer
articles.summary: Joe Biden says he didn't know he had cancer while he was president and wouldn't have sought a second term if he'd already been diagnosed

articles.title: Longtime GOP leader faces uncertain future after Jim Jordan wins House leadership fight
articles.summary: Steve Scalise declined to commit to serving a full term in the 120th Congress after losing the House Republican minority leader race to Jim Jordan.

articles.title: House Republicans elect Jim Jordan as minority leader for the next Congress
articles.summary: House Republicans on Tuesday elected Jim Jordan as minority leader for the next Congress, beating Majority Leader Steve Scalise, according to multiple sources.

articles.title: House Republicans Reject Impeachment Effort Against Hegseth
articles.summary: House Republicans voted to reject efforts by Rep. Thomas Massie (R-KY) and the Democrats to impeach Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.

articles.title: Hegseth decries impeachment effort with vote expected tonight
articles.summary: Republican Rep. Thomas Massie said a vote in the House is expected later Tuesday on the impeachment resolutions against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.
